usage: agentware index [-h] <subcommand> ...

positional arguments:
  <subcommand>
    add                 register a new entry in index.json
    remove              unregister an entry from index.json
    validate            validate index.json integrity
    sync                report (or --fix) unindexed *.md files
    migrate-frontmatter
                        one-time: backfill YAML frontmatter into every indexed
                        entry file
    rebuild             regenerate index.json + rosters + FEATURES.md from
                        entry frontmatter

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
